hypothesis: A compact Transformer that chooses among exact linear, contextual Hermite and shape references before applying a bounded residual will reduce the measured short-gap and cohort tail failures more reliably than a model forced to refine the shape reference alone.
controlled_changes: Add three observed-only procedural references and their deltas to the Transformer condition.
Predict one convex interval-level reference mixture, an authored-envelope pose residual and a residual confidence gate.
Add best-reference supervision, per-example relative position loss and an upper-quartile position penalty.
held_constant: The 153-channel semantic pose representation, original observed-only condition, velocity features and analytic C2 authored-key envelope.
The 1,840-clip, 85-subject, 7.158742-hour train split, balanced two-seed schedule and 48,000 examples per seed.
The compact four-block, four-head, width-128 encoder, AdamW settings, development controls and all original acceptance gates.
No style/contact labels, diffusion, runtime promotion or confirmation access. This is the final nearby Transformer/selector experiment if any development gate fails.

architecture.reference_weights: one convex mixture per request, produced by temporal mean pooling

data.sampling: Subject uniform, clip uniform within subject, start uniform within clip; gaps and contexts cycle; patterns 0, 1 and 2 are balanced inside every batch.

training.loss: unknown position MSE + 0.1 rotation6 MSE + 0.01 velocity MSE + 0.0001 acceleration MSE + 0.12 log relative position + 0.08 upper-quartile relative position + 0.08 best-reference cross entropy + residual/gate regularization
training.selection: Fixed final step only; no development checkpoint selection

evaluation.hard_stop: If either seed fails any partition or cohort gate, stop nearby Transformer/selector fitting and redesign data/representation/conditioning prospectively.
evaluation.confirmation: Protected confirmation clips remain sealed unless both seeds pass every development gate.
